title: AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) - official policy page
authority_note: Primary official EU policy page for the AI Act.
claims: AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689) is the first comprehensive legal framework on AI worldwide
Four risk tiers: unacceptable (9 banned practices), high, transparency, minimal/no
Prohibitions 1-8 effective Feb 2025; prohibition 9 (non-consensual explicit/CSAM generation) effective Dec 2026 via AI Omnibus
Transparency rules (chatbot disclosure, deepfake labelling, machine-readable marks) effective August 2026
draft_usage: Cited for EU AI Act structure and timing under Social (comparison table).
